basics.name: Aubin Birba
basics.label: Cybersecurity Engineer and PhD Candidate
basics.summary: Cybersecurity engineer and PhD candidate specialized in applied cryptography, with expertise in PKI, key management, and secure protocol design for high-assurance environments. Experienced in bridging research and practical implementation, delivering privacy-preserving solutions for cloud, distributed systems and machine learning, and integrating encryption services into critical applications.
